1. The ball is thrown by one player (the kicker) towards another player (the receiver).
2. The receiver catches the ball and throws it back to the kicker.
3. The kicker then throws the ball again towards the receiver.
4. The receiver catches the ball and throws it back to the kicker.
5. This continues until all players have had an opportunity to throw the ball.

The goal of kickball is to score points for your team by throwing the ball into the opposing team's basket or net. Each team has two players who are responsible for catching the ball and throwing it back to their teammates.

To avoid taking advantage of you, make sure that both players in each team know where the ball is going and what direction it needs to go. Also, be aware of the rules of the game and follow them carefully when playing kickball.
